item.text: {"search_note":"Gap: I found no direct evidence that Tinubu fabricated intelligence, invoked historical grievance in a systematic way, or spread false information himself to build support for conflict.","evidence":[{"title":"Text of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s New Year Address to the Nation","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"January 1, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/text-of-president-bola-ahmed-tinubus-new-year-address-to-the-nation/","summary":"Tinubu openly said 2024 would require revamping the economy and security, and he described 2023 as a difficult year. This is evidence of broadly truthful baseline messaging rather than invented threats.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.1","2B.3"]},{"title":"Ramadan: President Tinubu Appeals to Nigerians to Pray for Peace, Stability","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"March 12, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/ramadan-president-tinubu-appeals-to-nigerians-to-pray-for-peace-stability/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged that the country faced kidnapping, banditry, and other real threats, while urging peace and mutual support. This supports truthful public explanation of security problems rather than fearmongering.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.1","2B.3"]},{"title":"President Tinubu: We Must Embrace New Value System to Make Progress; Vandalization of Rail Tracks, Stealing of Electric Cables are Pure Acts of Sabotage","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"June 19, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-we-must-embrace-new-value-system-to-make-progress-vandalization-of-rail-tracks-stealing-of-electric-cables-are-pure-acts-of-sabotage/","summary":"Tinubu described infrastructure vandalism as sabotage and framed it as a national development problem. This is not clearly false, but it does show a tendency to cast public disorder in hard-security moral terms.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.3","2B.1"]},{"title":"President Tinubu’s Broadcast on the Nationwide Protest","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"August 4, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubus-broadcast-on-the-nationwide-protest/","summary":"Tinubu acknowledged that many protesters were motivated by legitimate hopes for a better country, but he also said some actors had a clear political agenda to tear the nation apart and warned against ethnic bigotry. This is mixed evidence: it contains some truthful acknowledgment, but also a strong threat-framing component.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.1","2B.3","1B.8"]},{"title":"President Tinubu Receives U.S Ambassador, Underscores Importance of Sustaining Democracy, Its Norms and Institutions","publisher":"State House, Abuja","date":"July 25, 2024","url":"https://statehouse.gov.ng/president-tinubu-receives-u-s-ambassador-underscores-importance-of-sustaining-democracy-its-norms-and-institutions/","summary":"Tinubu said protests are part of democracy, but the government will not condone demonstrations that destroy lives and property. This is a relatively measured public explanation of the limits of protest, not a clear case of misinformation.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.1","2B.3"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges protesters with treason, inciting military","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"September 2, 2024","url":"https://theprint.in/world/nigeria-charges-protesters-with-treason-inciting-military/2249248/","summary":"Nigerian prosecutors charged protesters with treason and alleged they intended to destabilize the country and incite mutiny. This is strong negative evidence that the administration responded to protest with threat amplification and legal escalation rather than careful public clarification.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.5","2B.4","2B.3"]},{"title":"Nigeria: Protesters Charged with Treason","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"September 6, 2024","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/09/06/nigeria-protesters-charged-treason","summary":"HRW said the treason charges against protesters sent a message of intolerance for dissent and should be dropped. This is negative corroboration for the idea that the state used fear and criminalization to build support for a coercive response.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.5","2B.4"]},{"title":"Nigeria charges 76, including minors, with treason after August protests","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"November 1, 2024","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/nigeria-charges-76-including-minors-with-treason-after-august-protests-3698000","summary":"Reuters reported that the government expanded treason charges to 76 people, including minors, after the August protests. This strengthens the negative reading that the state treated protest as a destabilization threat rather than a normal democratic challenge.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.5","2B.4"]},{"title":"Nigeria police chief warns against Kenyan-style protests","publisher":"Reuters via MarketScreener","date":"July 23, 2024","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Nigeria-s-police-chief-warns-against-Kenyan-style-protests-47446946/","summary":"Reuters reported that the police chief warned against “Kenyan-style” protests ahead of the August demonstrations. This is indirect but relevant: it shows a security framing that may have amplified fear before protests even began.","question_ids":["2B.6","2B.1","2B.3"]}]}
